title: Samiksha Adhikari / Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari Etc. (Gen. / Spl. Rectt.) Exam.-2026
summary: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has advertised recruitment for Samiksha Adhikari, Assistant Review Officer (ARO), Care Taker, and other posts under Advt. No. A-4/E-1/2026 totaling 501 vacancies. Eligible candidates holding a bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification can apply online through the official UPPSC candidate portal.
eligibility_bullets: Must possess a Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification from a recognized university.
Fulfill age limit criteria as per UPPSC recruitment rules.

vacancy_breakdown.category: Samiksha Adhikari / Sahayak Samiksha Adhikari and others

how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official UPPSC notification portal or Candidate Dashboard.
Complete One Time Registration (OTR) to obtain your unique OTR number.
Login using your OTR details to fill out the application form for Advt. No. A-4/E-1/2026.
Submit the application form and keep a printout for future reference.
